# pve_sdn_controller (Data Source)

Reads a single SDN controller object (`GET /cluster/sdn/controllers/{controller}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_sdn_controller" "bgp1" {
  controller = "bgp1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `controller` (String) The SDN controller object identifier to read.

### Read-Only

- `asn` (Number) Autonomous system number (BGP and EVPN only).
- `bgp_mode` (String) Whether eBGP or iBGP is used; one of `auto`, `external`, `internal` (BGP only).
- `bgp_multipath_as_path_relax` (Boolean) Whether different AS paths of equal length are considered for multipath computation (BGP only).
- `digest` (String) Digest of the controller section.
- `ebgp` (Boolean) Whether eBGP (remote-as external) is enabled (BGP only).
- `ebgp_multihop` (Number) Maximum amount of hops for eBGP peers (BGP only).
- `fabric` (String) SDN fabric used as underlay for this EVPN controller.
- `isis_domain` (String) Name of the IS-IS domain (IS-IS only).
- `isis_ifaces` (List of String) Interfaces where IS-IS is active (IS-IS only).
- `isis_net` (String) Network Entity title for this node in the IS-IS network (IS-IS only).
- `loopback` (String) Loopback/dummy interface providing the Router-IP (BGP only).
- `node` (String) Node where this controller is active.
- `nodes` (List of String) Cluster node names where this controller is active.
- `peer_group_name` (String) Name of the peer group for this EVPN controller.
- `peers` (List of String) Peer IP addresses.
- `route_map_in` (String) Route map applied to incoming routes.
- `route_map_out` (String) Route map applied to outgoing routes.
- `state` (String) State of the SDN configuration object; one of `new`, `changed`, or `deleted` when the configuration has not been applied yet.
- `type` (String) Controller plugin type; one of `bgp`, `evpn`, `faucet`, `isis`.
